title: Code for Image embeddings add limited predictive value to metadata in two NFT collections
description: Documentation-only correction to the frozen September 2026 BAYC/MAYC revision release. DATA_ACCESS.md now reproduces the DuneSQL query for the verified BAYC and MAYC contracts and distinguishes public query access from byte-identical reconstruction of the fixed historical export snapshot. Code, aggregate results and scientific conclusions are unchanged from v4.0.0. Raw transaction data, NFT images, embeddings, fitted models and row-level predictions remain excluded; full numerical refitting requires the documented inputs. Public tests do not constitute an independent full-data replication.
